During one of their adventures, the pair discover a secret cave that houses hundreds of wild dragons—and a mysterious ▇▇▇ rider with a startling connection to ▇▇▇. And as the ruthless conqueror ▇▇▇ Bludvist rises to seize control of both dragons and people alike, ▇▇▇ must step into his role as a true leader and, alongside his friends and ▇▇▇, protect Berk from a devastating war.
